subject.title: fix: deliver Codex-generated images on message-tool routes

question: Should `message_tool_only` permit explicitly harness-owned terminal artifacts, such as Codex-native generated images, to bypass model-source-reply suppression while preserving send-policy and room-event restrictions?
rationale: This is a deliberate change to the meaning of an existing user-configured delivery policy, not only a mechanical correction; maintainer intent is needed to define the durable exception boundary.

options.title: Accept the narrow host-artifact exception
options.body: Merge the provenance-limited behavior after confirming that provider-native terminal artifacts are intended host output rather than model-authored replies.

options.title: Keep strict message-tool-only delivery
options.body: Reject the bypass and require Codex-native image generation to invoke the normal visible-delivery mechanism before channel dispatch.

recommendation.title: Accept the narrow host-artifact exception
recommendation.body: Merge the provenance-limited behavior after confirming that provider-native terminal artifacts are intended host output rather than model-authored replies.

likelyOwner.reason: They supplied the detailed behavioral rationale and proof, although an established current-main owner should make the final product decision.
